rows.Origin:
Bred by David Kenny (Ireland, before 2013).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Style Roses in circa 2016.
rows.Bloom: Pink, yellow undertones. Mild fragrance. Semi-double to double, in large clusters, ruffled bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Climbing. Glossy, bronze-green foliage.

Height: 5'11" to 8'2" (180 to 250cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
